name: hlhb
plain_rule: RSI10与EMA5/10同根向上交叉且ADX>25时买入，同根向下交叉卖出，保留ROI与移动止损。

exact_rules.price_named_hl2: (open+close)/2, verified against actual TA-Lib RSI input; not conventional(high+low)/2
exact_rules.entry: RSI crosses above50 AND EMA5 crosses aboveEMA10 AND ADX>25 AND volume>0
exact_rules.exit_signal: RSI crosses below50 AND EMA5 crosses belowEMA10 AND ADX>25 AND volume>0

risks_and_missing: Master sayshl2 but source uses(open+close)/2; do not silently use(high+low)/2.

position_stacking="True" is a string strategy attribute. Reference Backtesting reads config["position_stacking"] defaultFalse, not this attribute; freeze actual config rather than pretending add-on logic is specified.
Source limit entry/exit orders must not be silently replaced with market orders. Freeze assumed limit placement/fill/timeouts and label execution hypothesis.
Concurrent entry can suppressROI because ignore_roi_if_entry_signal=True; ordinary ROI-only helper may be wrong.
ROI/trailing coexist; preserve fee-aware activation and same-entry-bar native behavior.
No original universe, position budget, costs, actual limit queue, author runtime or independent holdout available.

data_reference.locator: Dot must locate its already verified M0256 cache and check exact hash/bytes; this executor did not materialize the raw4h CSV
